path_policy: No absolute personal paths. External datasets are resolved at runtime from CRYPTOSHIFT_DATASET_DIR, CRYPTOSHIFT_CESNET_H5_PATH, CRYPTOSHIFT_PQC_OBS_CSV_PATH (see docs/data/DATASETS.md). All datasets are read-only inputs; derived output goes to scratch/derived/ (git-ignored).

datasets.name: CESNET-TLS22, provider-defined S subset
datasets.represents: Real encrypted TLS flow metadata captured on the CESNET2 network, 2021-10-04 to 2021-10-17 (14 daily tables).
does_not_represent: PQC deployment, adoption or migration ground truth (captured in 2021)
cryptographic algorithm labels (APP/CATEGORY identify services, not crypto)
datasets.allowed_use: Streaming, filtering and scale demonstrations only.
datasets.attribution: Jan Luxemburk and Tomas Cejka, 'Fine-grained TLS services classification with reject option', Computer Networks 220 (2023), 109467, https://doi.org/10.1016/j.comnet.2022.109467

checksum.source: manifest.json / verification.json of the dataset pack
checksum.note: File size and total row count were re-checked by `data-summary` (match); the 3 GB file was not re-hashed.

datasets.format: HDF5 written by PyTables, Blosc-compressed (filter 32001). h5py needs `hdf5plugin` to decode.

datasets.name: PQ Readiness Index - banking-sector public TLS endpoint observations (5 scans)
datasets.represents: 320 public TLS 1.3 endpoint handshake observations (64 pseudonymous banking hosts x 5 scan dates: 2026-04-23, 2026-05-10, 2026-09-03, 2026-09-14, 2026-10-02).
does_not_represent: a bank's internal inventory, source code, certificates, signatures or HSM state
overall migration readiness of any institution
detector ground truth for code/config scanning
datasets.allowed_use: Describe only as public-endpoint observations on the given dates.
datasets.attribution: Nguyen Dong, Global PQ Readiness Index (2026), https://github.com/xuxu298/PQReadinessIndex
datasets.duplicate_policy: Duplicates are counted and reported; a host repeating on different dates is a valid observation and is kept.
datasets.status_policy: status values (PQ-SAFE, CLASSICAL, ERROR) are kept unchanged; ERROR is unclassified.

datasets.name: PQ Readiness Index - banking rows from the 2026-10-02 run (tracked in repo)
datasets.represents: 64 public TLS 1.3 endpoint observations from one scan date (49 PQ-SAFE, 3 CLASSICAL, 12 ERROR). Subset of the 5-scan file above, different column layout.

datasets.name: Synthetic code/config fixtures
datasets.represents: Hand-written fixtures used to smoke-test detector logic (11 labelled instances) and the demo bank services.

datasets.name: Labelled lines from pinned public repositories
datasets.represents: Team annotations of cryptographic usage on specific files/lines of permissively licensed public repos at pinned commits.
does_not_represent: ground truth (annotations are single-annotator, review pending)
datasets.location: data/labels/public_code/ (pointers + labels); sources fetched into data/public/raw/ (git-ignored) by scripts/fetch_public_label_sources.py
datasets.in_git: labels and pointers only; no third-party source trees
